negative_reviews.author: Alzahraa Nagi Ali Al-Mughrbi
negative_reviews.text:
Not the best and NOT allergen friendly

The prices are a lot plus a service fee especially seeing as no waiter came to use for 20 mins despite the place not being crowded.
And not as allergen friendly as promised especially with nuts. For a restaurant that claims to be nut free MOST of the food was labelled by an employee (who knew alarmingly little about it herself) as “may contain nuts”. Apparently they don’t even know what’s in their own pastes and admit they might have nuts but can’t confirm it be liable or prevent cross contamination which is BS.

Also there’s a glitch in their app that gives £5 coupon and says it’s viable for two weeks but isn’t accepted after 29/10 so be careful for that

negative_reviews.author: Berke
negative_reviews.text:
I had really high expectations coming here but when I tried the Ramen with meat... I had the worst experience. I think it was mixed with some fish from other spoons because I tasted fish in my ramen.
Other than the horrible smell of the ramen, the restaurant is top tear looking but really loud inside. Every other minute the waitresses play the gong and its annoying after the tenth...
